<thought>Based on the ¹H NMR data, the molecule appears to be a homo‑allylic alcohol: a methyl group (3 H) coupled to a methine bearing an OH, which is coupled to a CH₂‑CH=CH₂ fragment. This fits the structure CH₃‑CH(OH)‑CH₂‑CH=CH₂, whose SMILES is “CC(O)CC=C”.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(O)CC=C</final_answer>
